title: Pleasing the Reader: Language Models Write for the Addressee, Not the Principal (BetrayalBench Benchmark & Dataset)
description: Complete BetrayalBench delegated-writing benchmark, 2,448 balanced model replies across 12 frontier models (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI), controlled 10-deal single-clause aspiration A/B ablation (660 paired replies), matched 324-pair execution-harness control, operational brief experiments, deterministic regex and dual-judge graders, statistical analysis code, and the 22-page technical paper.
